acquisition_method: Data acquisition was executed in data dependent mode with full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer and selection of top 20 ions with dynamic exclusion
alkylation_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
alkylation_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
cleavage_agent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
enrichment_method: FLAG-tagged proteins were purified with 10 uL anti-FLAG M2 magnetic beads (Sigma).
fractionation_method: Proteins from SILAC pull-down experiments were separated by SDS-PAGE and subjected to in-gel tryptic digest.
fragmentation_method: followed by collision induced dissociation (CID) analysis of fragment ions in the ion trap
instrument: and analyzed with an Orbitrap Elite mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS (Sigma, F0392) and stable isotope labeled lysine and arginine
mass_analyzer: full MS scans acquired in the Orbitrap mass analyzer
ptm: inferred: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
reduction_concentration: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
reduction_reagent: Gel bands containing proteins were cut, treated with 10 mM DTT and alkylated with 50 mM iodoacetamide before trypsin (Promega) digestion.
